data.body: Fixed: Modified run-hook.sh to capture hook stderr and append a '[hook location: $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run-hook.sh]' line when a hook exits with code 2 (BLOCKED). This ensures agents see the resolved plugin path in the error body even when the Claude Code harness shows the raw unexpanded '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}' token in the error prefix. Added test file tests/hooks/test-run-hook-blocked-annotation.sh with 4 behavioral tests covering: annotation present on block, exit code passthrough, no annotation on allow, body preserved.
